create_attrib_dataset_with_json: create an AttribDataset instance from an image directory and a JSON attribute dictionary file
create_attrib_dataset_imagefolder: create an AttribDataset that mimics torchvision ImageFolder format from a directory of categorized images
load_attrib_dict: load a JSON attribute dictionary mapping image filenames to their attribute key-value pairs
get_text_descriptor: get the text descriptor dictionary of attributes for a given image index in the dataset
get_key_orders: get the attribute key order and possible values for building labeled dataset key mappings
